cfbplotR: CFB Logo Plots in 'ggplot2'

Source: R/cfbplotR-package.R, R/geom_cfb_wordmarks.R
cfbplotR-package.Rd

A set of functions to visualize College Football analysis in 'ggplot2'.

Usage

GeomCFBwordmark

Format

An object of class GeomCFBwordmark (inherits from Geom, ggproto, gg) of length 5.
